'''Mioe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in [[Starwind Chandlery]], a general store and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitter that was located on [[StarForge Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]]. While the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Labio]] managed Starwind Chandlery, Mioe and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wurrooba]] clerked the store<ref name="Orbit" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> Mioe was small-sized for a Human.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mioe appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />
